title: I build modern web applications using React, TypeScript, and Next.js, focused on performance, accessibility, and best development practices.
about: I am a frontend developer focused on building modern, accessible, and responsive interfaces. I mainly work with React, TypeScript, Next.js, and TailwindCSS to develop scalable and well-structured web applications. In my projects, I pay special attention to clean code, component organization, and user experience. Currently, I continue improving my skills by exploring modern frontend tools and best development practices.
projectsSubTitle: A selection of projects that reflect my experience, dedication.

E-commerceStore.Name: E-commerce Store
E-commerceStore.ProjectDescription: An e-commerce web application built with Next.js. It allows users to browse products, filter them by category, sort them by price, view detailed product information, and manage them within a persistent shopping cart.
E-commerceStore.TechnologyDescription: Next.js with the App Router is used for page routing and navigation between views. Products are managed through local data within the project. Zustand handles the global cart state. TailwindCSS is used to build a modern, consistent, and responsive user interface.
E-commerceStore.Role: Full frontend design and development, including route architecture with Next.js, local data modeling, shopping cart implementation with global state, product filtering and sorting logic, and responsive interface development.
Features: Product listing with image, price, and rating
Category filtering (men, women, jewelry, electronics)
Price sorting (ascending and descending)
Shopping cart with counter, quantity updates, and item removal
Individual product detail page
Visual confirmation after completing a purchase
Fully responsive design for desktop and mobile devices

WeatherApp.Name: WeatherApp
WeatherApp.ProjectDescription: Weather web application developed with Next.js. Allows the user to search for a city and view the current weather, extended forecast, location map, and detailed weather data with custom animated icons.
WeatherApp.TechnologyDescription: Next.js with App Router is used for routing and rendering. TailwindCSS for utilitarian and responsive styles. React Leaflet displays an interactive map with coordinates. OpenWeatherMap API provides current weather data and extended forecast. Meteocons offers animated and custom SVG icons. TypeScript ensures strong typing in all components.
WeatherApp.Role: Full frontend development, API integration, local state management, dynamic weather data manipulation, animated icon integration, responsive design, and geographic visualization.
Features: Weather search by city (supports compound names)
Current weather display with custom animated icons
Extended 5-day forecast (filtered by specific time)
Detailed data: temperature, wind chill, humidity, pressure, clouds, visibility, and wind
Centered location map with marker using Leaflet
Modern styles with inner shadows and gradients using TailwindCSS
100% responsive design adapted for mobile and desktop

ResultadosElectorales.Name: Electoral Results
ResultadosElectorales.ProjectDescription: Interactive application that displays national election results. It allows you to view candidates, vote percentages, results by province, and dynamic charts with updates based on the election type (general or runoff).
ResultadosElectorales.TechnologyDescription: Next.js with TypeScript for a modular and efficient structure. TailwindCSS for a modern and responsive design. Recharts for dynamic visualizations of election data. Data is managed using custom hooks and strictly typed with TypeScript.
ResultadosElectorales.Role: Complete frontend design and development, including component structure, results visualization, interactive chart integration, typed data handling, and visual styling adapted to different devices.
Features: Results visualization by candidate and political group
Interactive pie chart of votes (positive, blank, invalid, contested)
Dynamic type selector Election (general/runoff)
Custom colors by political party
Data rendered with strong typing in TypeScript
Fully responsive design adapted to mobile and desktop screens
